# March for Life

> > The March for Life is America's largest annual pro-life demonstration, advocating for the protection of unborn life and the overturning of Roe v. Wade through peaceful activism, legislative action, and grassroots education.

Founded to peacefully protest the 1973 Roe v. Wade Supreme Court decision, the March for Life organizes the annual Washington, D.C. march each January and provides year-round advocacy through the March for Life Education and Defense Fund. Led by President Jeanne Mancini, the organization promotes pro-life legislation at federal and state levels, supports pregnancy resource centers, and mobilizes advocates nationwide.

- March for Life annual event

## Legislative Advocacy and Policy

- [Congress Must Defund Planned Parenthood](https://marchforlife.org/defund-planned-parenthood): Jeanne Mancini calls for Congressional defunding of Planned Parenthood
- [March for Life Statement on Supreme Court Confirmation Hearings](https://marchforlife.org/supreme-court-confirmation-hearings): Official statement supporting Judge Gorsuch's Supreme Court nomination
- [Illinois Law Mandates Abortion Promotion](https://marchforlife.org/illinois-law-mandates-abortion-promotion): Press release opposing Illinois SB 1554 conscience rights violation
- [Your Voice Is Needed to Support Pro-Life HHS Appointees Yoest and Manning](https://marchforlife.org/hhs-appointments): Call to action supporting Trump HHS appointees Yoest and Manning
- [President Codifies Pro-Life Language in Education Bill](https://marchforlife.org/pro-life-language-in-education-bill): Every Student Succeeds Act victory with abortion funding prohibition
- [Real Pro-Life Victories Happened on the State Level](https://marchforlife.org/real-pro-life-victories-happened-on-the-state-level): 2014 state election results and pro-life legislative gains analysis
